description: Attestation-gated, metered payments for AI agents on Solana devnet (Anchor 1.2.2). initialize, approve_measurement, register_provider, submit_attestation, approve_attestation, open_session, settle (two Ed25519-verified messages) and close_session were verified with exact token payouts.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of maitreya-ai/AgentsPay-Sol. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/AgentsPay-Sol. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and added scripts/sol-college-lab-flow.ts (the devnet flow, using the upstream SDK and a simulated TEE). The hosted IDL is the upstream SDK IDL with the lab address substituted; discriminators were confirmed by live transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (attestation lifecycle, session escrow, Ed25519 voucher/receipt settlement)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentspay/
QA: devnet proof of a metered session settled from signed messages
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise create_vault and open_session_from_vault with a period limit
